consent.title: Cookies for statistics
consent.text: Loopme can use Google Analytics (via Firebase) to see how the app is used. That sets cookies and sends usage data to Google, so it only happens if you allow it. Everything else works either way.

settings.description: Your choice is stored on this device only. You can change it at any time.

settings.devNote: This is a development build: no analytics is ever sent here, whatever you choose.
